info.name: BFF Calendar integration tests
info.description: MAIR-262: working checks (the BFF starts, resolves sessions against Core API, reaches Calendar API) and the event and invitations journey the Calendars front relies on, replayed by newman on docker-compose-integration.yml (./integration_test.sh). The seeded Admin (user 1), agent (user 2, role User) and Responsable (user 3, in group 20 with the agent) are impersonated with JWTs forged from the JWT_SECRET of the stack; the event is created by the agent and deleted at the end.

exec: // One fresh account per run so the collection is replayable against a persistent database.
// The seeded accounts have no known password: forge their JWT exactly like mairie360_api_lib::jwt_manager
// does (HS256, claims { sub, role, exp }), signed with the JWT_SECRET of the stack, injected by
// docker-compose-integration.yml (random per run, MAIR-428). `role` is the claim the BFFs read (MAIR-529).
const payload = b64url(cryptoJs.enc.Utf8.parse(JSON.stringify({ sub: String(sub), role, exp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000) + 3600 })));
